node.title: H3 norm-one torus affine quotient cap
node.statement: If H lies in the norm-one torus of a quadratic finite-field extension, every nondegenerate affine image meets H in at most two points. The H3 quotient affine pencil always includes the identity point, so R(t)<=1 for every nonidentity target. For p_M=2^31-1, the order-2^21 multiplicative subgroup of F_(p_M^4)^* lies in the quadratic norm-one torus; hence X_18<=(n-1)^2 and 17X_18<17n^2<300n^2 on that scoped subgroup instance. The deployed Mersenne-31 Chebyshev line round is not covered.
